name: Cinematic Scroll Website
philosophy: The page is a film and the visitor holds the playhead. Scroll is time: every section is a scene with an entrance, a beat and an exit, telling one story from start to finish.
principles: One narrative arc across the page, not a list of sections
Scroll position drives motion, so the visitor stays in control
Each scene has a single idea and a single focal point
A still frame of any scene should look composed
visualIdentity: Cinematic: full-viewport scenes, strong contrast, big type treated as an image, dramatic scale changes and letterbox-like framing.
artDirection: Think in shots: establishing shot, close-up, reveal, closing shot. A consistent light and colour grade across imagery. One recurring visual motif carries through the scenes.

layout.composition: Full-height scenes composed around one focal point, with type and image overlapping. A pinned horizontal strip or stepped sequence for the central part of the story. Almost no card grids.

typography: Very large display type with tight leading, revealed line by line. Short lines. Body copy is sparse and placed like subtitles.
colour: A controlled grade that may shift by scene: dark scenes are allowed when the story earns them, with palette changes used as chapter breaks.
contentPresentation: Script, not brochure: short lines in sequence, one idea per scene, the product or offer revealed after the story sets it up, a closing scene with the call to action.
assets: Large, high-quality stills or video with room for type. Video needs dense keyframes for scrubbing (the team hit lag with 2 keyframes in 241 frames). Authored vector scenes are fine when they have depth and layers.
animation: GSAP ScrollTrigger timelines: scrubbed reveals, pinned scenes, parallax between layers, split-line headlines, colour transitions between chapters. Motion always explains the story order.
scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll synced to ScrollTrigger. At least one pinned scene and one scrubbed sequence. Never trap the visitor: scenes end on their own and a skip is always possible by scrolling.
responsive: Scenes stay full height on mobile with recomposed framing. Horizontal strips become vertical steps or swipe. Reduced motion shows the stacked static layout with every word readable.
useCases: Premium business sites with a story to tell

compatibleWith.when: One shader scene is itself a chapter of the story
A frame sequence is the central scrubbed scene

fromTeam: Workbook: narrative storytelling with scrubbed timelines; 9-scene journey, pinned horizontal services strip, scrubbed product video, door transition, palette drift and sync issues
Skill: pinned ScrollStory and Chapter sections, GSAP, Lenis, fallbacks
interpreted: Film language, shot thinking, script-style copy
